subject: Conditional uplift options + co-term mechanics for Clarion Labs renewal
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@clarionlabs.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clarionlabs.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning: mid-contract growth and co-term ask

Hi Kimberly,

Hope youre well. Clarion is looking at a 40% usage increase for Q3 driven by a new feature experiment that will push inference into peak windows. Our renewal is Oct 1 and procurement asked whether we can: 
- add a mid-contract uplift now and get pro-rated pricing into the new term, and
- align (co-term) the new uplift to Oct 1 without creating separate invoices for the interim months.

Also, legal wants to understand any conditional discounts youd consider (e.g., usage-based tiering, commitment ladder) if we commit to a 12-month top-up. Can you share options and an indicative number we can show execs?

Appreciate a concise set of paths (preferably 2–3) so we can compare.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Singh
Head of Platform Ops, Clarion Labs

---
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@clarionlabs.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: mid-contract growth and co-term ask

Maya —

Thanks for the detail. Short answer: yes, we can support a mid-contract uplift and co-term it into your Oct 1 renewal. Ive sketched three practical paths below and attached a short spreadsheet with the math: Redwood_Uplift_Options_xlsx.xlsx.

Option A — Immediate top-up, full annualize at renewal:
- Add 40% additional committed capacity today, billed pro-rata for remainder of current term.
- On Oct 1, annualize the combined commit for the next 12 months at a 7% blended uplift discount (volume-weighted).
- Customer benefit: preserves predictable unit cost and avoids multiple invoices.

Option B — Conditional tier (performance-triggered discount):
- Top-up capacity now at current rates; if average monthly usage over next 90 days exceeds threshold X, apply a 10% rebate credit applied at renewal (not retroactive).
- Customer benefit: lower near-term rates only if sustained usage materializes.

Option C — Stepped voucher + co-term smoothing:
- Clarion purchases a voucher equal to 80% of expected uplift (discounted 12%). Voucher draws down as usage occurs; remaining usage billed pay-as-you-go until Oct 1 when remaining commitment is annualized.
- Customer benefit: lower effective price on committed portion, flexibility on actual consumption.

Ive looped in Priyom for finance/legal on any constraints and Ben for approval on discounting levers. If any of these lines look promising Ill put a formal proposal together (with precise pro-rata numbers and a DocuSign quote).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Uplift_Options_xlsx.xlsx

---
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: mid-contract growth and co-term ask

Kim / Ben —

Reviewed the three options. A couple of notes from finance & legal:
1) Option A: 7% blended uplift discount is acceptable for a one-time midterm annualize if Clarion increases committed spend by >=35% and signs amendment. Need PO or signed DocuSign before we annualize.
2) Option B (conditional rebate): Operationally heavier — requires monthly metering SLA and a reconciliation window. We can offer 8–10% rebate band, but it must be capped and paid as credit at renewal; cannot be applied retroactively beyond 90 days.
3) Option C (voucher): Approved — voucher discount up to 12% but vouchers must have a six-month drawdown period. If they dont draw, funds are credited but not refundable.

Also propose a fourth path (hybrid) to be pragmatic:
- Hybrid D: 30% immediate top-up with a 9% upfront discount + an additional 5% rebate if usage sustains above 120% of current baseline for 3 months. Co-term annualization on Oct 1 if the signed amendment is in place.

Ive attached a sample amendment template and a pricing worksheet for the specific numbers: Clarion_Renewal_Proposal_v1.pdf.

Priyom Das
Head, Deals & Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Clarion_Renewal_Proposal_v1.pdf

- Hybrid D headline: 9% upfront discount on 30% top-up + additional 5% credit at renewal if 3-mo sustained usage target hit. Effective discount on uplift approx ~11% if triggers are met.
